item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen mo'i rgyud las snyan rgyud thos grol bar do 'phrang sgrol
item.coloph: zhi khro bar do 'phrang sgrol zhes bya ba/ sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dam pa rang grol la snyan du brgyud nas/ shar pa rnal 'byor la bka' babs/ de nas rnal 'byor tog gi rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ bru rgyal ba g.yung drung sogs nas rim bzhin du brgyud do//
